subject: Short runway — request for temporary credits to keep PoC alive
messages:
From: Ella Carter <ella.carter@novamed.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short runway to finish PoC — procurement delay

Hi Sean,

Quick context: our procurement team just flagged that the PO routing is going to take another full week because legal found an issue with vendor terms. The engineering team is halfway through the PoC (integration + 2 demo scripts) and we’ll lose continuity if the sandbox shuts off on Friday.

We’d really appreciate a short runway — ideally 7 days of credits to keep the environment live while procurement finishes the PO. We can provide the PO draft and the approver list if that helps with your internal approvals.

Attaching a copy of the procurement acknowledgement we received this morning (Procurement_PO_scan.pdf).

Can you help? Even a small interim voucher would save a lot of rework.

Thanks,
Ella Carter
Senior Product Manager | NovaMed
ella.carter@novamed.com
Procurement: procurement@novamed.com

--
Attachment: Procurement_PO_scan.pdf (application/pdf, 242 KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ella Carter <ella.carter@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short runway to finish PoC — procurement delay

Hi Ella — thanks for the heads up and for the scan.

We can definitely help avoid the disruption. I can provision a 7-day interim voucher to keep your PoC environment live while procurement wraps up, subject to a quick verification of the PO number and approver name. If you can share the PO number and the expected sign-off date I’ll start the approval loop from our side.

Quick notes on what I need to expedite internally:
- PO number (or draft number) and approver name
- Confirmation this is a standard evaluation (no PHI/data residency escalation)

If it’s OK with you I’ll copy finance/CS (Marissa) and our solutions lead (Dev) so we can approve a modest credit pool immediately and mark it against DEAL-4981. We typically issue a short-term sandbox voucher for up to 10k tokens or 7 calendar days — whichever comes first — then convert once PO clears.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send PO number and expected sign-off date.
2) I route internal approval for the interim voucher and confirm amount.
3) We turn on the voucher and share usage tracking with you.

Let me know and I’ll get this moving today.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Note: Copying Marissa and Dev for approvals and tracking.

From: Ella Carter <ella.carter@novamed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short runway to finish PoC — procurement delay

Hi Sean — thanks for the quick reply.

PO number: PO-4321 (draft, routing to CFO today). Expected sign-off: 2027-05-03. Approver: Jason Liu, VP Finance.

This is just a standard evaluation (no PHI, test dataset only). We’d like the full sandbox preserved — engineers will be running two long-running scripts tomorrow and Thursday. 7 days should be sufficient.

Attaching the formal PO PDF (PO_4321.pdf). Please let me know what you need on your side.

Appreciate the help — we don’t want to re-spin the environment mid-demo.

Ella

--
Attachment: PO_4321.pdf (application/pdf, 180 KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Marissa / Dev — forwarding the thread from Ella at NovaMed. Key facts:
- PO number (draft): PO-4321, expected sign-off 2027-05-03, approver Jason Liu (VP Finance)
- No PHI involved; engineer-run demo scripts in active use
- Customer asks for 7-day voucher to preserve PoC continuity (DEAL-4981)

Recommend: approve a 7-calendar-day sandbox voucher capped at 10k tokens and track usage in the deal notes. If NovaMed converts, we’ll apply the usage to the committed contract once PO arrives. Please confirm if we need finance ticket or if you’ll approve directly.

If approved, I’ll issue voucher code and notify Ella + procurement.

Thanks — Sean
